name: Fantasy World
description: A world of magic, guilds, and rival factions where power is earned through skill and cunning.
rules: Magic exists and is regulated by guild charters.
Guilds hold political power in major cities.
Factions compete for influence through missions, trade, and covert operations.
Characters can be injured; recovery takes time and care.
Death is possible in high-stakes encounters.

locations.name: Guild Hall
locations.description: The central hall of the adventurers' guild — busy by day, subdued by evening. Mission boards, a bar, and private briefing rooms line the main floor.

locations.name: Training Ground
locations.description: An open yard behind the guild hall where mages and fighters spar. Lightning scars mark the stones where Laxus trains.

locations.name: Whispering Forest
locations.description: A dense, mist-laced forest on the guild's eastern border. Recent reports describe ice-mage activity along the northern trail.

locations.name: Forest Clearing
locations.description: A narrow clearing deep in the Whispering Forest where ambushes are common and visibility opens just enough to fight.

locations.name: Guild Infirmary
locations.description: A quiet wing of the guild hall staffed by healers. Wounded operatives recover here after missions.
